messages:
marta (People Ops): Heads-up — we have a visitor tomorrow at 11:00am: Lina Park (artist). She'll drop off an easel + a framed canvas crate around 10:30. Can someone cover front desk check-in, grab a dolly, and mark the crate as fragile? Also need a quick badge (Lina Park - Guest of Design). Thanks!

sam: I can cover 10:30–11:30 at the desk. I have a small dolly in my locker, will bring it. :truck: 

jen: I'll print the badge and slip it in an envelope. Do we want "Guest of Design" or "Artist Demo"? Also can set up a corner table for the demo.

marta (People Ops): "Artist Demo" sounds good — and corner table by the windows is perfect (reserve desk 7). Accessibility note: Lina asked for step-free access and a low stool.

alejandro: Will the crate go to Locker A3? That's our usual framed-art holding spot. If so I'll move it there and tag it fragile.

frontdesk-bot: Visitor pre-registration found: Lina Park — ID uploaded, vehicle plate ABC-321. Please add to sign-in sheet on arrival.

sam: Copy. I'll put a "FRAGILE" sticker and move crate to A3 after check-in. Pinged @facilities for the dolly.

facilities: Got it — we'll drop a folding dolly at the lobby by 10:15. Also bringing one extra set of moving straps. :gear:

marta (People Ops): Amazing, thank you. Jen — can you also print a temporary guest Wi-Fi card to go with the badge?

jen: Yep — Wi-Fi printed and taped to badge envelope. Network: RedwoodGuest2026 (expires EOD).

lina (guest): Hi everyone — Lina here. Thanks so much! I'll aim to arrive ~10:45 with one large framed piece (24x36) and a small crate. Demo at ~11:15. Appreciate the step-free note.

sam: Great — see you then. Quick reminder: please don't leave canvases propped in the main hallway, use Locker A3 or desk 7.

marta (People Ops): Also please log the delivery in the deliveries spreadsheet: https://redwood-internal/deliveries and add any weird notes in #help. If anything changes ping me. :heart:
